title: Displayed action hints like ["inspect","albany:wolf_preparation"] and… @ wolf_winter
excerpts: Displayed action hints like ["inspect","albany:wolf_preparation"] and ["talk",character_id,name] don't work as literal call syntax; the tool wants the plain id/character_id instead, causing avoidable rejected calls.
The row's shown action tuple ['inspect','albany:wolf_preparation'] is rejected as an invalid story_choice_id; only the bare id string works.
